overview: Aqua Sentry is a real-time environmental monitoring dashboard for surface water pollution detection. It uses AI-based object detection and IoT sensors to monitor lakes, ponds, and rivers — displaying live pollution levels, AI detections, sensor readings, trend analytics, and automated alerts.
features: Real-time pollution level gauge (Low/Medium/High) with animated status indicator
AI object detection panel with bounding boxes for plastic waste and debris
Water quality sensor cards for pH, Turbidity (NTU), and TDS (ppm) with range indicators
Pollution score analytics (0-100) with 24-hour trend charts
AI Prediction Panel showing 1-hour pollution forecast with confidence score
Eco Suggestion Box with contextual recommendations based on pollution level
Real-time color-coded alert panel with timestamps
Device status monitoring (Raspberry Pi, sensors, battery, connectivity)
Historical data visualization with pH, TDS, and pollution score trend graphs
